note: Operator guidance per reason code. Guidance never advises bypassing a source restriction or editing raw data to force acceptance. A manifest or mapping-profile correction is always distinct from changing the raw artifact, whose bytes are never rewritten by this workflow.

ABSOLUTE_PATH_IN_IDENTITY.inspect: artifact_relative_path; it must be a relative path under the bundle root.
ABSOLUTE_PATH_IN_IDENTITY.may_change: Use a relative path such as raw/your-export.csv.
ABSOLUTE_PATH_IN_IDENTITY.meaning: artifact_relative_path is absolute or escapes the intake root.
ABSOLUTE_PATH_IN_IDENTITY.must_not_guess: Do not embed a machine-specific absolute path.
ABSOLUTE_PATH_IN_IDENTITY.why_blocked: Blocks at load: absolute/machine paths never enter deterministic identity.

AMBIGUOUS_TIMEZONE.inspect: Whether the export provides UTC or an explicit offset instead of local time.
AMBIGUOUS_TIMEZONE.may_change: Re-declare event_timezone as UTC or an explicit offset if the export supports it.
AMBIGUOUS_TIMEZONE.meaning: A local timestamp is ambiguous (a daylight-saving fall-back repeats the hour).
AMBIGUOUS_TIMEZONE.must_not_guess: Do not pick one side of the repeated hour.
AMBIGUOUS_TIMEZONE.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the instant is not unique, so it is never guessed.

ARTIFACT_BYTE_LENGTH_MISMATCH.inspect: The real byte length (historical-bar-hash) versus the declared value.
ARTIFACT_BYTE_LENGTH_MISMATCH.may_change: Recompute and set artifact_byte_length for the exact file placed under raw/.
ARTIFACT_BYTE_LENGTH_MISMATCH.meaning: The raw file's byte length differs from artifact_byte_length in the manifest.
ARTIFACT_BYTE_LENGTH_MISMATCH.must_not_guess: Do not resave or reformat the raw file to reach the declared length.
ARTIFACT_BYTE_LENGTH_MISMATCH.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: the manifest no longer describes the exact bytes.

ARTIFACT_EMPTY.inspect: Whether the export completed and was copied fully.
ARTIFACT_EMPTY.may_change: Replace with the complete raw export and update sha256/byte_length.
ARTIFACT_EMPTY.meaning: The raw file exists but has zero bytes.
ARTIFACT_EMPTY.must_not_guess: Do not fabricate rows to fill an empty file.
ARTIFACT_EMPTY.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: an empty export carries no bars.

ARTIFACT_MISSING.inspect: The bundle root, the raw/ folder, and artifact_relative_path spelling.
ARTIFACT_MISSING.may_change: Fix artifact_relative_path, or place the exact raw file where it points.
ARTIFACT_MISSING.meaning: No file was found at the manifest's artifact_relative_path under the bundle root.
ARTIFACT_MISSING.must_not_guess: Do not substitute a different file to make the path resolve.
ARTIFACT_MISSING.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: nothing can be validated or normalized.

ARTIFACT_SHA256_MISMATCH.inspect: The real SHA-256 (historical-bar-hash); whether line endings changed on copy.
ARTIFACT_SHA256_MISMATCH.may_change: Recompute and set artifact_sha256 for the exact file placed under raw/.
ARTIFACT_SHA256_MISMATCH.meaning: The raw file's SHA-256 differs from artifact_sha256 in the manifest.
ARTIFACT_SHA256_MISMATCH.must_not_guess: Do not edit raw bytes to reach the declared hash.
ARTIFACT_SHA256_MISMATCH.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: the bytes were altered or the wrong file is present.

CASE_ASSOCIATION_WITHOUT_DECLARATION.inspect: Nothing to change in Batch 04; association is future authorized work only.
CASE_ASSOCIATION_WITHOUT_DECLARATION.may_change: Nothing in this batch; do not attempt association here.
CASE_ASSOCIATION_WITHOUT_DECLARATION.meaning: An association was attempted without a declared, validated mapping.
CASE_ASSOCIATION_WITHOUT_DECLARATION.must_not_guess: Do not link a bundle to any real case during Batch 04.
CASE_ASSOCIATION_WITHOUT_DECLARATION.why_blocked: Blocks: Batch 04 performs no case association at all.

CASE_COVERAGE_INCOMPATIBLE.meaning: A mapping's required session coverage is incompatible with the bundle's coverage.
CASE_COVERAGE_INCOMPATIBLE.must_not_guess: Do not force a coverage match during Batch 04.
CASE_COVERAGE_INCOMPATIBLE.why_blocked: Future-work guard: coverage compatibility is checked only in later authorized work.

CASE_INTERVAL_INCOMPATIBLE.meaning: A mapping's required interval is incompatible with the bundle's interval.
CASE_INTERVAL_INCOMPATIBLE.must_not_guess: Do not force an interval match during Batch 04.
CASE_INTERVAL_INCOMPATIBLE.why_blocked: Future-work guard: interval compatibility is checked only in later authorized work.

CASE_SYMBOL_INCOMPATIBLE.meaning: A mapping's symbol is incompatible with the bundle's manifest symbol.
CASE_SYMBOL_INCOMPATIBLE.must_not_guess: Do not force a symbol match during Batch 04.
CASE_SYMBOL_INCOMPATIBLE.why_blocked: Future-work guard: symbol compatibility is checked only in later authorized work.

CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE_BAR.inspect: The conflicting rows and why the export produced both.
CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE_BAR.may_change: Obtain a clean export without conflicting duplicates.
CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE_BAR.meaning: Two rows share a start time but disagree on values.
CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE_BAR.must_not_guess: Do not pick one conflicting row over the other.
CONFLICTING_DUPLICATE_BAR.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: which conflicting bar is correct is never guessed.

CONTRADICTORY_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.may_change: Correct whichever field is mis-declared to match the export.
CONTRADICTORY_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.meaning: Price adjustment and corporate-action handling disagree (e.g. adjusted price, raw handling).
CONTRADICTORY_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.must_not_guess: Do not pick one field arbitrarily to resolve the conflict.
CONTRADICTORY_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: the declared semantics are internally inconsistent.

COVERAGE_GAP.inspect: Whether gaps are expected (halts, closed session) for this data.
COVERAGE_GAP.may_change: Set session_coverage_policy to ALLOW_GAPS if gaps are legitimate.
COVERAGE_GAP.meaning: Consecutive bars leave a gap but continuity was required.
COVERAGE_GAP.must_not_guess: Do not synthesize filler bars to close the gap.
COVERAGE_GAP.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle when session_coverage_policy is REQUIRE_CONTINUOUS.

CREDENTIAL_LIKE_VALUE_PRESENT.inspect: Every manifest/profile value for accidentally pasted credential material.
CREDENTIAL_LIKE_VALUE_PRESENT.may_change: Remove the credential-like value; declare only provenance and semantics.
CREDENTIAL_LIKE_VALUE_PRESENT.meaning: A field contains credential-like material (a login pass-phrase, API key, or token).
CREDENTIAL_LIKE_VALUE_PRESENT.must_not_guess: Do not obfuscate credential material to pass the check.
CREDENTIAL_LIKE_VALUE_PRESENT.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: credentials must never enter intake artifacts.

CURRENT_VALUE_AS_HISTORICAL.inspect: Whether the export is a live snapshot or a true historical extract.
CURRENT_VALUE_AS_HISTORICAL.may_change: Provide a genuinely historical export and declare HISTORICAL.
CURRENT_VALUE_AS_HISTORICAL.meaning: data_time_basis is CURRENT, so the values are a live view, not historical.
CURRENT_VALUE_AS_HISTORICAL.must_not_guess: Do not relabel a current view as historical.
CURRENT_VALUE_AS_HISTORICAL.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: current values cannot substitute for historical ones.

DATA_TIME_BASIS_UNKNOWN.inspect: Whether the export is a historical snapshot or a live/current view.
DATA_TIME_BASIS_UNKNOWN.may_change: Set data_time_basis to HISTORICAL only when the export truly is historical.
DATA_TIME_BASIS_UNKNOWN.meaning: data_time_basis is UNKNOWN, so it is unclear whether values are historical or current.
DATA_TIME_BASIS_UNKNOWN.must_not_guess: Do not declare HISTORICAL to get past the check.
DATA_TIME_BASIS_UNKNOWN.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: current values must not be ingested as historical.

DUPLICATE_TIMESTAMP.inspect: Whether the duplicates are truly identical and the duplicate_policy setting.
DUPLICATE_TIMESTAMP.may_change: Choose the duplicate_policy that matches your intent for identical rows.
DUPLICATE_TIMESTAMP.meaning: Two or more rows share the same bar start time.
DUPLICATE_TIMESTAMP.must_not_guess: Do not delete rows to remove duplicates silently.
DUPLICATE_TIMESTAMP.why_blocked: Identical duplicates quarantine (collapse); under REJECT_ALL_DUPLICATES they reject.

EVENT_TIME_OUTSIDE_COVERAGE.inspect: The declared coverage window against the actual first/last bar times.
EVENT_TIME_OUTSIDE_COVERAGE.may_change: Widen expected_start_time/expected_end_time to the true coverage if intended.
EVENT_TIME_OUTSIDE_COVERAGE.meaning: A bar falls outside the manifest's declared expected_start_time/expected_end_time.
EVENT_TIME_OUTSIDE_COVERAGE.must_not_guess: Do not drop or move the out-of-window bar.
EVENT_TIME_OUTSIDE_COVERAGE.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the bundle claims a coverage window the data exceeds.

INVALID_BOUNDARY_DURATION.inspect: timestamp_semantics and bar_interval against the row timestamp.
INVALID_BOUNDARY_DURATION.may_change: Correct timestamp_semantics or bar_interval if mis-declared.
INVALID_BOUNDARY_DURATION.meaning: A bar's computed end is not strictly after its start.
INVALID_BOUNDARY_DURATION.must_not_guess: Do not extend the bar to a positive duration by hand.
INVALID_BOUNDARY_DURATION.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the bar has no positive duration.

INVALID_OHLC_RELATIONSHIP.inspect: The OHLC column mapping; a swapped high/low is a common cause.
INVALID_OHLC_RELATIONSHIP.may_change: Fix the OHLC column mapping if columns were transposed.
INVALID_OHLC_RELATIONSHIP.meaning: A bar violates high >= max(open,close,low) or low <= min(open,close,high).
INVALID_OHLC_RELATIONSHIP.must_not_guess: Do not reorder or clamp OHLC values to make them valid.
INVALID_OHLC_RELATIONSHIP.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the OHLC values are internally impossible.

INVALID_TIMESTAMP.inspect: The timestamp column mapping and timestamp_format against the raw rows.
INVALID_TIMESTAMP.meaning: A row timestamp is missing or unparseable.
INVALID_TIMESTAMP.must_not_guess: Do not fill in a plausible timestamp for a broken row.
INVALID_TIMESTAMP.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the bar cannot be placed in time.

MALFORMED_DECIMAL.inspect: decimal_separator and thousands_separator_policy against the raw numbers.
MALFORMED_DECIMAL.meaning: A numeric field is not a valid decimal under the profile's separators.
MALFORMED_DECIMAL.must_not_guess: Do not rewrite the raw number to a clean form.
MALFORMED_DECIMAL.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the value cannot be parsed deterministically.

MALFORMED_MANIFEST.inspect: The manifest against the intake-manifest template and field guidance.
MALFORMED_MANIFEST.may_change: Fix the manifest JSON: add required fields, correct types, remove guidance keys.
MALFORMED_MANIFEST.meaning: The manifest JSON is not a valid IntakeManifest (missing/invalid fields).
MALFORMED_MANIFEST.must_not_guess: Do not invent provenance values to satisfy the schema.
MALFORMED_MANIFEST.why_blocked: Blocks at load: preflight cannot build the manifest object.

MALFORMED_ROW.inspect: delimiter and has_header against the raw line.
MALFORMED_ROW.may_change: Correct delimiter/has_header if the profile mis-describes the CSV.
MALFORMED_ROW.meaning: A row cannot be split into the expected fields.
MALFORMED_ROW.must_not_guess: Do not hand-edit the broken raw line.
MALFORMED_ROW.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the record is structurally broken.

MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.inspect: schema_version and intake_contract_version against the template defaults.
MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.may_change: Set the versions to the values in the current template.
MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.meaning: The manifest declares a schema/contract version this batch does not accept.
MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.must_not_guess: Do not force an unsupported version through.
MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: the declared contract does not match this workflow.

MARKET_VENUE_MISMATCH.inspect: The venue column values against market_or_venue.
MARKET_VENUE_MISMATCH.may_change: Correct market_or_venue, or the venue_column mapping, to match the export.
MARKET_VENUE_MISMATCH.meaning: A row's venue disagrees with the manifest market_or_venue.
MARKET_VENUE_MISMATCH.must_not_guess: Do not overwrite the row venue to match.
MARKET_VENUE_MISMATCH.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the bundle would mix venues.

MISSING_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.inspect: The provider's documentation for how prices and volume are adjusted.
MISSING_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.may_change: Set price/volume adjustment and corporate_action_handling to declared values.
MISSING_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.meaning: A price/volume/corporate-action semantic is UNKNOWN, so adjustment meaning is undefined.
MISSING_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.must_not_guess: Do not guess raw vs adjusted from the price magnitudes.
MISSING_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: adjustment cannot be inferred from the numbers.

MISSING_INTERVAL.may_change: Declare bar_interval to match the export.
MISSING_INTERVAL.meaning: No bar_interval is declared, so bar duration is undefined.
MISSING_INTERVAL.must_not_guess: Do not infer interval from row spacing.
MISSING_INTERVAL.why_blocked: Blocks at load: the manifest requires an explicit interval.

MISSING_OHLC_VALUE.inspect: The OHLC column mappings and null_tokens against the raw rows.
MISSING_OHLC_VALUE.may_change: Fix the OHLC column mapping if a real value was misread as null.
MISSING_OHLC_VALUE.meaning: A required open/high/low/close value is missing for a row.
MISSING_OHLC_VALUE.must_not_guess: Do not fill a missing price from a neighboring bar.
MISSING_OHLC_VALUE.why_blocked: Blocks the row: OHLC is never inferred.

MISSING_TIMESTAMP_SEMANTICS.inspect: The provider's documentation for whether timestamps mark bar open or close.
MISSING_TIMESTAMP_SEMANTICS.may_change: Set timestamp_semantics to START or END per the provider's definition.
MISSING_TIMESTAMP_SEMANTICS.meaning: timestamp_semantics is not START or END, so bar boundaries are undefined.
MISSING_TIMESTAMP_SEMANTICS.must_not_guess: Do not assume START without confirming the provider's convention.
MISSING_TIMESTAMP_SEMANTICS.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: whether a timestamp labels the bar start or end is unknown.

MIXED_INTERVALS_UNDECLARED.inspect: Row spacing against the declared bar_interval.
MIXED_INTERVALS_UNDECLARED.may_change: Split the export into single-interval bundles, each declared correctly.
MIXED_INTERVALS_UNDECLARED.meaning: Rows imply more than one bar interval but a single interval was declared.
MIXED_INTERVALS_UNDECLARED.must_not_guess: Do not resample mixed bars into one interval.
MIXED_INTERVALS_UNDECLARED.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: mixed intervals are not silently reconciled.

NAN_OR_INFINITY.inspect: Whether the export emitted NaN/inf placeholders for missing data.
NAN_OR_INFINITY.may_change: If NaN means null, map it via null_tokens; otherwise the row stays blocked.
NAN_OR_INFINITY.meaning: A numeric field is NaN or infinity.
NAN_OR_INFINITY.must_not_guess: Do not replace NaN/inf with a fabricated number.
NAN_OR_INFINITY.why_blocked: Blocks the row: non-finite values are never accepted.

NEGATIVE_TRADE_COUNT.inspect: The trade_count column mapping and the raw values.
NEGATIVE_TRADE_COUNT.may_change: Fix the trade_count_column mapping if a wrong column was mapped.
NEGATIVE_TRADE_COUNT.meaning: A row carries a negative trade count.
NEGATIVE_TRADE_COUNT.must_not_guess: Do not take the absolute value of a negative trade count.
NEGATIVE_TRADE_COUNT.why_blocked: Blocks the row: trade count cannot be negative.

NEGATIVE_VOLUME.inspect: The volume column mapping and the raw values.
NEGATIVE_VOLUME.may_change: Fix the volume_column mapping if a non-volume column was mapped.
NEGATIVE_VOLUME.must_not_guess: Do not take the absolute value of negative volume.
NEGATIVE_VOLUME.why_blocked: Blocks the row: volume cannot be negative.

NONEXISTENT_LOCAL_TIME.inspect: Whether the export mislabels timezone, or provides UTC/explicit offset.
NONEXISTENT_LOCAL_TIME.may_change: Re-declare event_timezone as UTC or an explicit offset if the export supports it.
NONEXISTENT_LOCAL_TIME.meaning: A local timestamp falls in a daylight-saving spring-forward gap that never occurred.
NONEXISTENT_LOCAL_TIME.must_not_guess: Do not shift the time into the adjacent valid hour.
NONEXISTENT_LOCAL_TIME.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the instant does not exist, so it is never invented.

NON_MONOTONIC_ORDER.inspect: The raw row order and the sort_expectation setting.
NON_MONOTONIC_ORDER.may_change: Set sort_expectation to STABLE_SORT_BY_EVENT_START if unordered input is acceptable.
NON_MONOTONIC_ORDER.meaning: Rows are not sorted by time but the profile requires presorted input.
NON_MONOTONIC_ORDER.must_not_guess: Do not reorder the raw rows in place to fake presorting.
NON_MONOTONIC_ORDER.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle when sort_expectation is REQUIRE_PRESORTED.

OVERLAPPING_BARS.inspect: bar_interval and timestamp_semantics against the row spacing.
OVERLAPPING_BARS.meaning: A later bar starts before the previous bar's end.
OVERLAPPING_BARS.must_not_guess: Do not trim bars to remove the overlap.
OVERLAPPING_BARS.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: overlapping bars are inconsistent.

SYMBOL_MISMATCH.inspect: The symbol column values against provider_symbol.
SYMBOL_MISMATCH.may_change: Correct provider_symbol, or the symbol_column mapping, to match the export.
SYMBOL_MISMATCH.meaning: A row's symbol disagrees with the manifest provider_symbol.
SYMBOL_MISMATCH.must_not_guess: Do not overwrite the row symbol to match.
SYMBOL_MISMATCH.why_blocked: Blocks the row: the bundle would mix instruments.

SYNTHETIC_VALUE_AS_HISTORICAL.may_change: Set intended_use to INFRASTRUCTURE_FIXTURE for synthetic data.
SYNTHETIC_VALUE_AS_HISTORICAL.meaning: A SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE bundle is declared as HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE.
SYNTHETIC_VALUE_AS_HISTORICAL.must_not_guess: Do not relabel synthetic data as vendor-supplied historical evidence.
SYNTHETIC_VALUE_AS_HISTORICAL.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: synthetic values cannot represent historical evidence.

UNKNOWN_BOUNDARY_ID.meaning: A case-association mapping references a boundary id not in the known set.
UNKNOWN_BOUNDARY_ID.must_not_guess: Do not substitute a real boundary id during Batch 04.
UNKNOWN_BOUNDARY_ID.why_blocked: Future-work guard: association validates references only, and only later.

UNKNOWN_CASE_ID.inspect: Not applicable in Batch 04; the case-association template is placeholder-only.
UNKNOWN_CASE_ID.meaning: A case-association mapping references a case id not in the known set.
UNKNOWN_CASE_ID.must_not_guess: Do not substitute a real case id into the template during Batch 04.
UNKNOWN_CASE_ID.why_blocked: Future-work guard: association validates references only, and only later.

UNKNOWN_TIMEZONE.inspect: event_timezone; prefer UTC or an explicit offset like -05:00 when IANA data is absent.
UNKNOWN_TIMEZONE.may_change: Set event_timezone to UTC, an explicit offset, or a resolvable IANA zone.
UNKNOWN_TIMEZONE.meaning: event_timezone could not be resolved (unknown name, or IANA data unavailable).
UNKNOWN_TIMEZONE.must_not_guess: Do not infer the timezone from the symbol or venue.
UNKNOWN_TIMEZONE.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: timestamps cannot be anchored to an instant.

UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.inspect: The supported price/volume adjustment options in the adjustment guide.
UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.may_change: Re-declare using a supported adjustment value if it matches the export.
UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.meaning: A declared adjustment semantic is outside the supported set.
UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.must_not_guess: Do not map an unsupported adjustment onto a supported one.
UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT_SEMANTICS.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: the declared adjustment cannot be represented.

UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING.inspect: The real file encoding; supported values are utf-8, utf-8-sig, ascii, latin-1.
UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING.may_change: Set profile.encoding to the export's actual supported encoding.
UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING.meaning: The declared profile.encoding is not one this batch can decode.
UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING.must_not_guess: Do not guess an encoding that silently corrupts characters.
UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: the text cannot be decoded deterministically.

UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.inspect: The export's real format; whether a delimited CSV export is available.
UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.may_change: Provide a CSV export and set artifact_format to CSV.
UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.meaning: artifact_format is a declared format this batch does not normalize (only CSV).
UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.must_not_guess: Do not relabel a non-CSV file as CSV.
UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: only CSV is normalized this batch.

UNSUPPORTED_INTERVAL.inspect: Whether a supported fixed interval (1/5/15/30 minute or 1 hour) export exists.
UNSUPPORTED_INTERVAL.may_change: Provide an export at a supported fixed interval and declare it.
UNSUPPORTED_INTERVAL.meaning: bar_interval is a session-based or otherwise unsupported interval this batch cannot bound.
UNSUPPORTED_INTERVAL.must_not_guess: Do not resample or convert bars to a supported interval by hand.
UNSUPPORTED_INTERVAL.why_blocked: Blocks the bundle: daily/irregular bars are not silently converted.
